parsed.self_critique_fixed: Applied the Hindi language module and global rules. Ensured high-quality code-mixing (T1) using standard WhatsApp-style romanization (T10). Pronunciation words in Scene 1 are kept verbatim English (T2a). Applied T4 politeness: Rahul addresses his friend Amit using the casual 'tum' register, while referring to Miss Nova with respectful plural verbs ('banati hain', 'explain karti hain'). Replaced 'your own language' with 'Hindi' in Scene 2 per T5. Converted all numbers to English numerals ('12 years', '3 a.m.', '1000 mistakes', '15 minutes') per T2h. Run a self-critique pass to strip out any formal/Sanskritized Hindi, replacing them with highly colloquial spoken phrasing like 'Arre bas kar', 'time waste karna band karo', and 'lost feel na karo' to keep the script natural and anti-newspaperish (T3).

violations.quote: Character B stands beside him, listening passively and looking slightly embarrassed when referenced.
violations.why: The ad sets up a shame hook by correcting and embarrassing Amit, but fails to resolve it into triumph or respect, leaving him humiliated.
violations.fix: Modify the visual so Amit actively downloads the app or practices with a smile, showing a clear path to triumph.

safety.summary: The ad violates G3.1 (Severe) because the shame hook involving Amit's pronunciation errors does not resolve in dignity or triumph.
